warnings: EPS uses DeviceRGB sRGB numeric values; EPS has no portable embedded sRGB profile. Viewer/printer colour settings can change appearance.
Smooth tracing approximates raster artwork. Gradients/photos and antialiased lettering may produce many paths or visible differences; inspect enlarged previews. Lower path counts can reduce fidelity.
Preserve detail uses unsimplified traced contours (VTracer fitting=none, Potrace alphamax=0). Pixel stair steps can remain; the detail slider affects curve fitting only when smoothing is enabled.
